svg.title: Tapped delay line of a 5-tap FFE
svg.desc: The input passes four delays of one symbol period T. Each of the five pick-offs is weighted by a tap c0 to c4 and the products are summed into the output. Tap c2 is the main cursor; c0 and c1 are pre-cursor taps, c3 and c4 post-cursor taps.

path.style: fill: none; stroke: #8b1a1a; stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linejoin: miter
